description: Retrieves checklists (primarily structure/metadata, not detailed item history) from a Trello board, with options to include associated card and check item details and to control which fields are returned for each entity.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving checklists from a specific Trello board.

card_fields.description: Specifies fields of associated cards to return; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., name, idList, badges).
card_fields.title: Card Fields

cards.description: Determines which cards (and their checklists) are considered when fetching checklists. Valid values: 'all', 'closed', 'none', 'open', 'visible'.
cards.title: Cards

checkItem_fields.description: Specifies fields of check items to return; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., name, nameData, pos, state, type).
checkItem_fields.title: Check Item Fields

checkItems.description: Determines if check items (individual items within a checklist) are included in the response. Valid values: 'all', 'none'.
checkItems.title: Check Items

fields.description: Specifies fields of the checklists to return; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., idBoard, idCard, name, pos).
fields.title: Fields

filter.description: Filters the checklists to be returned. Valid values: 'all' (all matching checklists) or 'none' (no checklists).
filter.title: Filter

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board from which to retrieve checklists.
idBoard.title: Id Board

inputSchema.title: GetBoardsChecklistsByIdBoardRequest

name: get_boards_checklists_by_id_board

CheckItem.description: Individual check item within a checklist.

due.description: Due date for the check item in ISO 8601 format
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: Number of minutes before the due date when a reminder should be sent
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

id.description: Unique identifier for the check item
id.title: Id

idMember.description: ID of the member assigned to the check item
idMember.title: Id Member

nameData.description: Additional data about the item name
nameData.title: Name Data

pos.description: Position of the check item, used for ordering
pos.title: Pos

CheckItem.title: CheckItem

disableAt.description: The maximum number of check items allowed before creation is disabled
disableAt.title: Disable At

warnAt.description: The threshold at which warnings should be shown
warnAt.title: Warn At

checkItems.description: Array of check items within the checklist
checkItems.title: Check Items

idBoard.description: ID of the board the checklist belongs to
idBoard.title: Id Board

idCard.description: ID of the card the checklist is attached to
idCard.title: Id Card

pos.description: Position of the checklist, used for ordering
pos.title: Pos

GetBoardsChecklistsByIdBoardResponse.description: Contains the retrieved checklists from the specified Trello board.

checklists.description: Array of checklist objects on the board
checklists.title: Checklists
